name: Euler V2
description: Euler revolutionizes DeFi by letting any asset become collateral for a lending market. Lenders and borrowers get market leading risk-adjusted rates. Builders can create and manage markets exactly how they want them, with institutional-grade security.

methodology.Fees: Includes interest that is paid by the borrowers, protocol and curators fees.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Fees distributed to vaults lenders and curators.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Revenue used for buy back EUL tokens.

Fees.Borrow Interest: Interest paid by borrowers to lenders (excluding protocol and curators fees).

SupplySideRevenue.Borrow Interest: Interest paid by borrowers to lenders (excluding protocol and curators fees).

HoldersRevenue.Token Buy Back: Revenue used for buy back EUL tokens.
